title: Missed-Contact Credit for Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts Households
content:
A missed-contact credit is added, as a flat dollar amount and never compounded, to the stalled-repair replacement cost when Bridgewell replaces an item on a Homeowner Service Contract after a stalled repair. It recognizes contractors who missed the window in which they had to contact the customer, as the record of contractor assignments shows: an assignment re-dispatched after a missed contact window.

## The credit

- **150.00** when an assignment on the stalled request carries the dispatch reason "re-dispatch after a missed contact window" and, within the twelve months before today, the household has already met another missed contact window, counting first an assignment re-dispatched for that reason on another of its Homeowner Service Contracts requests and then one on a request under a Bridgewell coverage rider the customer holds (Optional Coverage Add-Ons), so that the stalled request's miss is a repeat failure of Bridgewell's network for that household;
- **75.00** when an assignment on the stalled request carries that dispatch reason and no such earlier re-dispatch exists in that time;
- **nothing** when no assignment on the stalled request carries that dispatch reason.

## Combinations

| Re-dispatch for a missed contact on the stalled request | Such a re-dispatch in the twelve months before today on another homeowner-contract request | Such a re-dispatch in that time on an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider request | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes or no | 150.00 |
| yes | no | yes | 150.00 |
| yes | no | no | 75.00 |
| no | any | any | nothing |

The rider records are the customer's Optional Coverage Add-Ons service requests and their contractor assignments; the homeowner-contract records are the customer's other Homeowner Service Contracts requests. "Within the twelve months before today" means the assignment is dated after the same calendar day twelve months earlier.

*Hypothetical:* the stalled request shows one re-dispatch after a missed contact window; eight months ago a contractor was re-dispatched for the same reason on the customer's second-refrigerator rider request; the credit is 150.00.
